items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And that's how I met Herschel. I couldn't play much --

ctx.x: Yeah, we formed it as a dance band. And we learned those things like "The Moon Comes Over the Mountain," and "Carolina Moon," and which is that "Farewell to Thee." Every blues that Mamie and Bessie and all of them sang, we had those down, you know. One of the guys sang, the piano player sang in the group. And so we -- that really started -- got me interested.

And while I was working with our group, the Moonlight Serenaders, we had Sammy LePalm's orchestra in. That was the Holmes Brothers. They had a band, and they'd hire me on their jobs when I wasn't busy with my own. And that's how I met Herschel. I couldn't play much --
: Well, wait a minute. Is this band -- you're playing what?
